title: FlowerTweaks
description: Toggleable tweaks for flowers and greenery
body:
# Flower Tweaks

A mod that adds toggleable tweaks and features for default Minecraft greenery.

Currently this mod adds:
- enablePlantOnLeavesAndMoss - Allows flowers and greenery to be placed on top of Leaf Blocks, Mossy Cobblestone and Mossy Stone Brick.
- enableHangingRootsPlacement - Allows placing hanging roots on the bottom of Leaf Blocks.
- enableSporeBlossomPlacement - Allows placing spore blossoms on the bottom of Leaf Blocks.
- enableTorchflowerLight - Gives Torchflowers from the sniffer the ability to produce light.
- torchflowerLightLevel - How bright the Torchflower should glow (10 default).

These can all be modified in the mod's config.

![Flowers and Greenery placed on leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43ba85c16222c10e73b06afac78a845fe8cced20.png)
